chapter.verse: Tua ahih ciangin Abram, Izipt panin amah leh a zi, ama’ neih khempeuh leh Lot tawh zong Negeb gam lamah paito hi.
Tu-in Abram in ganhing, ngun, leh kham hau mahmah hi.
Amah Negeb gam pan kipanin Beth-el ciang dong, a kipat cil-a ama’ puanbuk a omna-sa mun Beth-el leh Ai kikal,
a masa-a biakna tau khat a bawlnasa munah khualzinin paisuak hi; tua lai munah Abram in Topa ’ tungah thungen hi.
Abram tawh a pai khawm Lot in zong tuuhon leh ganhon leh puanbukte nei a,
tua ahih manin mun khat-a teng khawm dingin leitang in amaute gel vak zo lo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amau’ neihsate tam mahmah ahih manin amaute teng khawm thei lo uh a,
Abram’ gancingte leh Lot’ gancingte kitawng zel hi. Tua hun lai takin Kanaan mite leh Perez mite tua gamah teng uh hi.
Tua ciangin Abram in Lot kiangah, “Nang leh kei’ kikal, nang’ gancingte leh kei’ gancingte’ kikal-ah kitotna omsak kei ni; bang hang hiam cih leh eite a kibeh i hi hi.

Na mai-ah gam buppi om hilo ahi hiam? Kei’ kiang panin nangmah paikhia tawm in. Nang in veilam na lak leh, kei taklam-ah ka pai ding hi; tua ahih kei leh zong, nang in taklam na lak leh, kei veilam-ah ka pai ding hi,” ci hi.

Lot zong khuadak a, Jordan gun kuam mun khempeuh in lim takin tui ngahin, Topa ’ huan hita leh, Zoar lam-a Izipt gam tawh hita leh kibang hi ci-in mu hi; hih pen Topa in Sodom leh Gomorrah a suksiat hun ma ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Lot in ama adingin Jordan kuam khempeuh teel a, Lot nisuahna lamah pai hi; tua ahih manin amaute kikhen tuak uh hi.
Kuam sunga khuapite' lakah Lot tengin a puanbukte Sodom ciang dongah khinin a om laitakin Kanaan gamsungah Abram teng hi.
Tu-in Sodom mite mi gilo uh a, Topa ’ tungah nakpi tak-a a khialte ahi uh hi.
Ama’ kiang panin Lot a paikhiat khit ciangin Topa in Abram’ kiangah, “Khuadak to in la, nangma' omna panin leilu lam, leitaw lam, nisuahna lam leh nitumna lam en in;
bang hang hiam cih leh na muh gam khempeuh nang leh na suan-le-khakte’ tungah kong pia paisuak ding hi.
Na suan-le-khakte leitung leivui zahin ka bawl ding hi; mi khatpeuh in leitung leivui a sim theih leh na suan-le-khakte zong kisim thei ding hi.
Tho in la, gam dung gam vai kan tanin pai in, bang hang hiam cih leh nang’ tungah kong pia ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Abram in a puanbuk khinin, Hebron gamsung, Mamre tawsawte’ gei-ah hong pai-in teng hi; tua lai munah Topa adingin biakna tau khat a bawl hi.
